SHIP-02.answer: Verification is policy you configure: hooks run commands and can block actions or task completion (exit code 2), /verify builds and drives the app, /goal re-checks a completion condition, and /code-review and managed Code Review provide independent review. Managed settings can restrict which hooks run (allowManagedHooksOnly), but the docs do not state that a check must pass before delivery.
SHIP-02.sub.independent_review: supported: /code-review reviews the current diff or a PR for correctness bugs (ultra runs a deep cloud review); managed Code Review (Team/Enterprise, research preview) reviews GitHub PRs with a fleet of specialized agents.
SHIP-02.sub.failure_blocking: supported: Exit code 2 blocks the action (hooks guide). TaskCompleted with exit code 2 prevents task completion, and TeammateIdle with exit code 2 sends feedback that keeps the teammate working.

SHIP-05.sub.commit_links: partial: OTel commit and pull request counters record counts of commits and PRs created, not links to them.
SHIP-05.sub.pr_links: supported: --from-pr opens the session picker filtered to sessions linked to a pull request.

SHIP-06.sub.grouping: unknown: /batch splits one large change into 5 to 30 worktree subagents; that is task splitting, not a review grouping.

OWN-01.answer: Claude Code is proprietary: the public repository LICENSE.md states "© Anthropic PBC. All rights reserved. Use is subject to Anthropic's Commercial Terms of Service." The sandbox runtime (Apache-2.0) and the Python Agent SDK (MIT, per GitHub) are open source components.
OWN-01.sub.client_license: supported: LICENSE.md: "© Anthropic PBC. All rights reserved. Use is subject to Anthropic's Commercial Terms of Service." The GitHub API reports no license for the repository.
OWN-01.sub.hosted_extensions: partial: The Python Agent SDK repository (MIT per GitHub) and sandbox-runtime (Apache-2.0) are open source; hosted-service licensing was not separately established.

OWN-03.answer: Prompts and outputs go to Anthropic (or the chosen provider) over TLS 1.2+; consumer plans train on data only when the setting is on, commercial plans do not by default; standard retention is 30 days for commercial and 30 days or 5 years for consumers. OWN-03.sub.consent_prompt: unknown: First-run telemetry prompts were not observed. The documented session-survey follow-up asks before any transcript upload; that is a separate consent step, not a telemetry prompt.
OWN-03.sub.provider_separation: supported: Third-party providers default telemetry off, except that hosts setting CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST default metrics on.

OWN-07.sub.report_access: partial: The security page links the Trust Center for the SOC 2 Type 2 report and ISO 27001 certificate; whether they cover Claude Code scope was not stated and the Trust Center was not readable.
